system: Product Reinvention Hub — Insurance Import Pipeline

stages.name: Sheet resolution
stages.logic: Regex on sheet name; combined regex covers ISO template names and component-model variants

stages.name: Header detection
stages.logic: Score each of the first 20 rows by how many field-alias groups it matches. Threshold: score >= 3. Returns -1 (skip sheet) if nothing clears threshold.
stages.tolerance: Headers at arbitrary row positions; title/desc rows above data are ignored

passes.name: Exact squish match
passes.algorithm: squishStr(header) compared against squishStr(alias) for each field. Case-insensitive, alphanumerics only.

passes.name: Fuzzy word-overlap
passes.algorithm: For unmapped fields: share significant words (excl. stop-words) between header and any alias. Map if shared/min(hw,aw) >= 0.5
passes.purpose: Handles novel templates with paraphrase column names

stages.name: Coverage hierarchy resolution
stages.output: Parent-before-child ordered array safe for sequential mutate() writes

stages.name: LD table parsing
stages.markerCol_detection: Auto-detected by scanning first 20 rows for each pattern

field_tables.FW_FIELDS: Coverage framework: id, coverage, subCoverage, requirement, premiumGen, bureau, proprietary
field_tables.FORM_FIELDS: Forms: number, edition, category, admitted, mandatory, attachment, display
field_tables.RULE_FIELDS: Rules: id, condition, outcome, reference, category, subCategory
field_tables.RATE_FIELDS: Rating: stepId, rules, algorithm, calc, rounding, reference
field_tables.DYN_FIELDS: Dynamic fields: number, fieldName, dataType, repeating

ingestion_pathways.name: PDF Rate Filing Importer
ingestion_pathways.source_format: PDF — regulatory rate filings, carrier filings
ingestion_pathways.grounding_invariant: Every AI claim cites a source paragraph from the input document. Responses without citations are rejected.

ingestion_pathways.name: Base Form Upload (Claims Analysis)
ingestion_pathways.trigger: User drag-drops or clicks to upload on Claims page

steps.name: Blob upload
steps.encoding: Chunked base64 (32KB chunks — avoids btoa call-stack overflow on large PDFs)

steps.name: DB create (PROCESSING)
steps.data: storagePath, url, mediaType, fileName, uploadedBy, uploadedByName, status: PROCESSING
steps.note: Record appears immediately in UI as 'Reading form…'

steps.name: Identify
steps.fast_path: Regex extracts form number (ISO 2-pair pattern). Returns immediately if bureau prefix recognized.
steps.ai_fallback: claude-haiku-4-5 forced tool call to identify_form schema
steps.update: adapter.db.mutate({ op: 'update', data: { ...ALL_FIELDS_FROM_STEP_1, title, formNumber, edition, lob, status } })
steps.critical: op:update is a FULL Cosmos Upsert. All base fields (storagePath, url, etc.) must be re-sent or they are wiped.

atomic_batch_ops: 1. Entity Upsert — the actual entity data
3. Version Upsert — field diff for this revision
5. GroundingChunk Upsert + int8 embedding — RAG retrieval
persistence.tenant_isolation: Every read/write scoped to JWT tenantId. Partition key + WHERE tenantId filter on every query.
persistence.update_semantics: FULL REPLACE (Upsert). Not a partial patch. All fields that must survive must be re-sent.

invariants.no_bare_writes: All writes via adapter.db.mutate(). Never direct SDK calls in app/ components.
invariants.refid_verbatim: RefId is raw cell value. Only docId transformation: dots to dashes.
invariants.no_fabrication: Importers return only what source cells contain. Empty string, not invented data.
invariants.ai_server_side: No AI SDK calls in app/src/. All AI is /api/ai/* server-side.

known_gaps.description: PR ISO TABLES sheet — non-standard flat rate matrix, no block markers
IM component-model workbooks contain no forms sheet
IM workbooks contain no ROC/rating sheet
GL Optional Forms Rules has no equivalent in IM/PR templates
